title: Single tracer-based protocol for broad-spectrum kinase profiling in live cells with NanoBRET
protocol: Passage HEK-293 cells one day prior to transfection using DMEM + 10% FBS.
Trypsinize the cells and inactivate trypsin with complete growth medium.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g / 4°C to generate a cell pellet.
Resuspend HEK293 cells for transfection at a density of 2 × 10^5/mL in Opti-MEM + 1% FBS.
Add 100 μL/well of resuspended HEK293 cells to each well of a TC-treated, 96-well plate.
Dilute NanoLuc® control vector in Transfection Carrier DNA at a ratio of 1 part NanoLuc® control vector to 9 parts Transfection Carrier DNA.
Further dilute the DNA solution with TE Buffer to achieve a final working concentration of 20 μg/mL.
Transfect at least 4 wells for transfection control purpose.
Dilute the MET-NanoLuc plasmid into Carrier DNA to match experimental conditions.
Assemble 2× Kinase DNA solutions and transfer to a sterile 96-well polypropylene plate.
Thaw frozen DNA quickly at 37°C if necessary, then centrifuge briefly to collect solution at bottom of vessel.
Prepare 2× Fugene HD solution by diluting Fugene HD to a final concentration of 60μL/mL in room temperature OptiMEM.
Add equal parts of the 2× Fugene HD solution to the 2× Kinase DNA solutions.
Mix on an orbital shaker for 15 s at 400 rpm.
Allow complexes to form for 30 min at room temperature.
Transfer 5 μL per well of the Transfection Complex into 100 μL/well of the 96-well plate with HEK293 cells.
Incubate 16–24 h at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Prepare 3× Complete NanoBRETTM Nano-Glo® Substrate in OptiMEM without serum or phenol red.
Mix gently by inverting 5–10 times in a conical tube.
Add 50 μL per well of 3× Complete NanoBRETTM Nano-Glo® Substrate with NanoBRETTM Extracellular Inhibitor for a 96-well plate.
Incubate 2–3 min at room temperature.
Add 50 μL per well of 3× Complete NanoBRETTM Nano-Glo® Substrate with NanoBRETTM Extracellular Inhibitor.
Incubate the wells at room temperature for 2–3 minutes.
Measure donor emission at 450 nm and acceptor emission at 610 or 630 nm using a NanoBRET™-compatible luminometer.
Determine the signal-to-background (S/B) ratio in the 450 nm channel by dividing RLUs from transfected cells + NanoGlo reagents by RLUs from NanoGlo reagents alone.
Introduce NanoBRET(TM) Tracer K10 at appropriate concentrations to quantify occupancy of each kinase.
Incubate the cellular system with NanoBRET™ tracers for 2–3 hours to achieve equilibrium.
Calculate the number of data points needed for each concentration bin based on the plate layout.
Prepare a 100× solution of NanoBRET(TM) Tracer in DMSO.
Dilute the master stock to prepare 100 μM tracer (1:4 dilution).
Dilute the master stock to prepare 25 μM tracer (1:16 dilution).
Dilute the master stock to prepare 10 μM tracer (1:40 dilution).
Dilute the master stock to prepare 2.5 μM tracer (1:160 dilution).
Add tracer dilution buffer to the 100× Tracer solutions to generate 20× Complete Tracer Dilution Buffer.
Dilute 1 part 100× tracer with 4 parts tracer dilution buffer.
Mix the concentrated tracer stock and DMSO in a conical tube.
Add Tracer Dilution Buffer to the mixed solution and mix thoroughly.
Dispense 5 μL of Complete 20× NanoBRET™ Tracer Reagent per well into transfected cells.
Mix on an orbital shaker for 15 seconds at 900 RPM at room temperature.
Dilute the test compound to 1000× in DMSO (or the appropriate solvent).
Prepare 10× test compounds in OptiMEM by diluting from the 1000× solution.
For the DMSO control, dilute 10 μL of DMSO to 1 mL with OptiMEM.
Add 10 μL per well of 10× test compound or 10 μL of the DMSO control to cells containing 1× tracer.
Mix on an orbital shaker for 15 seconds at 900 RPM.
Incubate the plate at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator for 2 hours.
Allow the plate to cool to room temperature for approximately 15 minutes before proceeding.
Prepare 3× Complete NanoBRETTM Nano-Glo® Substrate in OptiMEM without serum or phenol red by diluting NanoBRETTM Nano-Glo® Substrate 1:166 and Extracellular NanoLuc Inhibitor 1:500.
Mix gently by inverting the solution 5–10 times in a conical tube.
Add 50 μL of the 3× Complete NanoBRETTM Nano-Glo® Substrate to each well of a 96-well plate.
Incubate for 2–3 minutes at room temperature.
Measure donor emission (e.g., 450 nm) and acceptor emission (e.g., 610 nm or 630 nm) using a NanoBRET™-compatible luminometer.
